items.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
items.a: No. You can start on the free plan instantly — no credit card required. Upgrade only when you're ready to scale.
Yes. Pro and Enterprise plans keep selling even without internet. Transactions sync automatically once you're back online.
QRIS, cash, debit and credit cards, and major e-wallets. All payments reconcile into a single dashboard.
Absolutely. The Enterprise plan gives you a unified dashboard across all locations with per-store reports and roles.

items.a: Plans are billed per store, per month. Add terminals or stores anytime — you only pay for what you use.
Yes. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, backed by a 99.9% uptime SLA on Enterprise plans.
